hbx_upgrade_explain.definition: Prior HBX_HOLDS_UPGRADED counted in-memory name+country overlaps between HBX pack and Cvent candidates during the Core Identity run. It did NOT remove those candidates from holds-ledger.json.
hbx_upgrade_explain.note: Prior HBX_HOLDS_UPGRADED=3879 was an in-memory overlap count only; holds-ledger.json was not rewritten. Reconciliation now removes resolved rows from the active HOLD queue. TOTAL_REMAINING_HOLDS previously counted all historical ledger rows (including ones already in Census).
